title: Acme technical review
body:

title: Proposal follow-up
body:
Priya Shah: Our CFO signed off the target: close in 5 days by Q4, which she values at about 200k a year in audit and overtime.
Priya Shah: Marcus has told the board this is his priority for Q3 and he wants to be on the next call.
Priya Shah: The scoring sheet is agreed: audit trail 40 percent, rollout speed 30, price 30, and we weighted rollout after your demo.
Priya Shah: Security review first, then a steering committee vote in July, then procurement.
Priya Shah: Procurement uses a standard MSA and legal turnaround is about ten working days.
Priya Shah: If we miss the audit deadline again we lose the clean opinion, and that is a covenant issue with the bank.
Priya Shah: I presented the business case to the exec team on Tuesday and they asked me to bring you in.
Priya Shah: LedgerPro could not do the audit trail in the demo, so you are the preferred option now.
Sam Okafor: Thanks, let me summarise what I heard and we can agree the next step.
Priya Shah: Sounds good.
summary: Proposal follow-up: the CFO confirmed the target and the champion took the business case to the exec team.
